notes: The domain-restricted search surfaced NHS trust leaflets and protocols (no nhs.uk national page exists for this procedure). Excerpts support: infection uncommon (<1 in 100; septic arthritis rare and an emergency), warfarin not a contraindication, post-procedure flare for 24-48 hours, skin atrophy/depigmentation at the site, rest about 24 hours, seek care for redness/warmth/fever. New fluid-analysis content (viscosity, cell count, neutrophils, Gram stain vs culture, crystal examination, glucose/protein/lactate) and the cellulitis-over-site absolute contraindication are standard StatPearls/textbook material. 24-48 hour rest figure predates the patch. StatPearls URLs use unusual but valid NCBI path forms; flagged unverified only. No protected field changed.
